provenance.paper_title: GA-VLN: Geometry-Aware BEV Representation for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation

representation_paths.memory_component: agent-centric Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) spatial representations carrying geometry-aware features

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: BEV map entries representing the local spatial structure with geometry-aware encoding. navigation policy reads geometry-aware BEV maps for action selection.

BEV map updates as the agent moves through the environment. For GA-VLN, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of agent-centric Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) spatial representations carrying geometry-aware features.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (agent-centric Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) spatial representations carrying geometry-aware features) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
